transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because I’m terrified of flying now. Just thinking about getting on a plane scares me so badly. I know it doesn’t really make sense, but my body keeps telling me the plane is going to fall.
Aside from flying, do you experience intense fear or anxiety in other situations, such as in crowds or on other forms of public transportation?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed that in other situations.
Did this fear start after you experienced a specific frightening or traumatic event?
Yes. It started about seven months ago, after a really turbulent flight on a small plane. That was around when I lost my clinic job, too.
Do you have unwanted, distressing memories or nightmares where you feel as though you are reliving that turbulent flight?
No, I don’t have nightmares about it or feel like I’m reliving the flight.
